title: Signing in
summary: Get your password link, sign in, and find the demo and the guide.

shots.title: Email
shots.text: Type the email address the program has for you.

shots.title: Password
shots.text: Type your password. Passwords are stored only as scrambled hashes.

shots.title: Sign in
shots.text: Opens your pathway. Five wrong tries lock the email for 15 minutes.

shots.title: First time here, or forgot your password?
shots.text: Click this the first time you sign in, or whenever you forget your password.

shots.title: Email me a link
shots.text: Type your email and click Email me a link. The link works once and lasts 24 hours.

shots.title: Set your password
shots.text: The link opens this page. Choose 10+ characters with a letter and a number, type it twice, and click Set password and sign in.

shots.title: Explore the demo
shots.text: Choose mentor/coach, board president, superintendent, or site administrator. All public demo views use sample people and are view only.

shots.title: Choose a role
shots.text: View as a mentor/coach, board president, superintendent, or site administrator. Board president is a sample preview, not a live login.

shots.title: How-to guide
shots.text: Step-by-step help with pictures, even before you sign in.

title: Getting around
summary: Tabs, Back, Help, your password, and signing out.

shots.title: Tabs
shots.text: Switch between My Pathway, Calendar, Course Catalog, Phases, Badges, Hours, Evaluation, and Standards Alignment.

shots.title: My Pathway
shots.text: Where you are, what is coming up, your phases, badges, hours, and evaluation.

shots.title: Calendar
shots.text: Sessions, coaching, assignments due, and offerings you can enroll in, by month.

shots.title: Course Catalog
shots.text: Sign up for workshops and events, and choose your strand or academy.

shots.title: Phases
shots.text: Select a phase to review its requirements and classes.

shots.title: Badges
shots.text: Review phase, Competency Series, and session badges.

shots.title: Hours
shots.text: See totals and the log, and submit learning hours.

shots.title: Evaluation
shots.text: Choose MSBA, MARE, a local tool, or standards only. This tab is hidden from mentors.

shots.title: Standards Alignment
shots.text: Review evidence by DESE standard and print your report.

shots.title: Back
shots.text: Goes back one screen, for example from the calendar to your pathway.

shots.title: Help
shots.text: Opens the how-to guide, with pictures and Show me buttons.

shots.title: Change password
shots.text: The key button changes your password.

shots.title: Sign out
shots.text: Ends your session on this device.

title: Explore the demo by role
summary: Choose and switch roles, including coach, mentor, board, superintendent, and administrator previews.

shots.title: Choose a role
shots.text: Explore the demo opens four choices. Every public preview is view only and uses sample people.

shots.title: Mentor/coach: coach view
shots.text: The coach preview shows a sample roster of their own people. Notes and goals follow each superintendent’s sharing choices.

shots.title: Mentor view
shots.text: Switch to Mentor/coach: mentor view. Evaluation and coaching notes are hidden.

shots.title: Board president view
shots.text: One page: the superintendent’s completed learning by standard and the goals they chose to share. Nothing else.

shots.title: Superintendent preview
shots.text: One sample pathway, with Calendar, Course Catalog, Phases, Badges, Hours, Evaluation, Standards Alignment, and Sharing & goals.

shots.title: Site administrator preview
shots.text: The sample roster and every pathway tab. In this public preview, approvals and changes are turned off.

title: Using the Phases tab
summary: Read each phase’s requirements and open its classes.

shots.title: Phases
shots.text: Open Phases for Onboarding, Year 1, Year 2, and Year 3. Cards show badge status, hours, and required events.

shots.title: Phase details
shots.text: Select a phase to see required events, your strand or academy, and progress toward its badge.

shots.title: Open a class
shots.text: Click a class title for session details, materials, and assignments.

shots.title: Back to the phase
shots.text: Back returns to the Phases tab and the phase you selected.

title: Using the Badges tab
summary: Understand phase, series, and session badges and follow their standards.

shots.title: Badges
shots.text: Open Badges to review phase badges, Competency Series, and the MASA/TQC Pathway Certificate.

shots.title: Session badges
shots.text: Session badges show aligned DESE and AASA standards and earned hours.

shots.title: Follow a standard
shots.text: Click a session badge to open its standard in Standards Alignment, with events and a sample goal.

shots.title: Back to badges
shots.text: Back returns to Badges. The certificate recognizes professional learning, not Missouri educator certification.

title: Using the Hours tab
summary: Read totals and the log, and submit hours for approval.

shots.title: Hours by category
shots.text: Open Hours to see coaching, mentoring, and other learning totals.

shots.title: Hours log
shots.text: Review dates, categories, phases, hours, and approval status. Notes follow the role’s privacy rules.

shots.title: Log hours
shots.text: Choose the category, hours, date, and phase, and add a short note. Do not enter student names.

shots.title: Approval and counting
shots.text: Member entries wait for administrator approval before they count toward phase badges. Mentors log Mentoring hours only.

title: Using the Evaluation tab
summary: Choose the board’s evaluation tool and prepare a blank local tool.

shots.title: Evaluation
shots.text: Open Evaluation and choose MSBA, MARE, a local tool, or standards only. Mentors cannot see this tab.

shots.title: Aligning evaluation
shots.text: The selection and labels update immediately. This message stays visible while the choice saves; you can browse other tabs.

shots.title: Saved alignment
shots.text: Wait for Evaluation saved before changing this person’s choice again. If saving fails, the previous alignment returns with a refresh or retry message.

shots.title: Your local tool
shots.text: Name the district’s tool and upload a blank copy only. Do not upload ratings, board comments, or student information.

shots.title: Use the alignment report
shots.text: Standards Alignment organizes the evidence for board discussion and printing. Public preview choices are not saved.

title: Using Standards Alignment
summary: Expand your evidence by standard and print a board-ready report.

shots.title: Standards Alignment
shots.text: Open Standards Alignment for pathway work grouped under the five DESE superintendent standards, with the AASA crosswalk.

shots.title: Expand the evidence
shots.text: Expand all or open a single standard to review events, completed work, earned hours, and sample goals.

shots.title: Print report
shots.text: Print or save the report as a PDF to discuss with your board. Adapt sample goals to your district.

shots.title: Collapse the report
shots.text: Collapse all returns to a compact list. Evaluation details appear only for authorized roles.

title: Your pathway
summary: Where you are, what is next, and how phases work.

shots.title: Where you are
shots.text: Your phase (Onboarding, Year 1, Year 2, or Year 3), your coach, and your mentor.

shots.title: Leadership pipeline
shots.text: Your total hours, phases completed, and what is left for the current phase badge.

shots.title: Coming up
shots.text: Your next sessions, coaching calls, and assignments due. Click one to open the class.

shots.title: The four phases
shots.text: Each phase earns a badge. Click a phase to see its events.

shots.title: Phase details
shots.text: Required events, your strand or academy, and the hours you have toward the badge.

shots.title: Class titles
shots.text: Click any class title to open its class page.

title: Using the calendar
summary: See every session, coaching call, and due date by month.

shots.title: Change months
shots.text: Use ‹ and › to move between months, and Today to come back.

shots.title: Colors
shots.text: Sessions, coaching, assignments due, offerings you can still enroll in, and completed classes.

shots.title: An item
shots.text: Click any item to open that class.

shots.title: The month
shots.text: Today is circled. Dates marked as samples are filled in for the demo.

title: Taking a course
summary: Home, Modules, requirements, assignments, quizzes, and pathway credit.

shots.title: Course navigation
shots.text: Home, Modules, Assignments, Discussions, Resources, and People.

shots.title: Your progress
shots.text: Requirements you have finished in this course.

shots.title: Announcements
shots.text: News from your instructor, newest first.

shots.title: Modules
shots.text: The course by week or topic. Each item shows what it takes to finish.

shots.title: Locked module
shots.text: Opens when you finish the module before it, or on its date.

shots.title: Videos and pages
shots.text: Videos play in the course. Watching alone never finishes a course.

shots.title: Assignments and quizzes
shots.text: Everything to turn in, with due dates and your status.

shots.title: Quizzes
shots.text: Start the quiz, answer, and submit. Essays wait for your instructor.

shots.title: Pathway credit
shots.text: Finish every requirement and the course goes to an administrator to approve for your hours. It counts once.

title: Course discussions
summary: Create, read, post, reply, moderate, and see unread posts.

shots.title: Discussions
shots.text: A red number shows posts you have not read.

shots.title: Topics
shots.text: Each discussion in the course. Instructors click New discussion and choose whether it is graded.

shots.title: Read and reply
shots.text: Click Reply under a post, or write your own and click Post. Instructors can remove any post; others remove their own.

shots.title: Who can see it
shots.text: Only people taking the course, its instructors, and program administrators.

title: Enrolling in courses
summary: Use the Course Catalog to sign up for workshops and events.

shots.title: Browse & enroll
shots.text: Opens the Course Catalog (so does the Course Catalog tab).

shots.title: My enrollments
shots.text: Everything you have signed up for.

shots.title: An offering
shots.text: Date, format, hours, and the DESE standard it is aligned to.

shots.title: Enroll
shots.text: Signs you up. It goes on your Coming up list and calendar.

shots.title: Enrolled
shots.text: Click Drop if your plans change.

title: Hours, badges, and your evaluation
summary: Log hours, request a substitution, and use your badges with your board.

shots.title: Log hours
shots.text: Log coaching, mentoring, conferences, and other learning. An administrator approves them.

shots.title: Hours form
shots.text: Pick the category, hours, date, and phase, add a note, and click Log hours.

shots.title: Request substitution
shots.text: Count equivalent learning (prior experience, district training) in place of an event.

shots.title: Badges
shots.text: Phase and Competency Series badges, and the MASA/TQC Pathway Certificate when all four phases are done.

shots.title: Evaluation
shots.text: Choose MSBA, MARE, your district’s own tool, or standards only.

shots.title: Print report
shots.text: Prints the Standards Alignment Report to bring to your board.

title: For coaches and mentors
summary: See your people, log hours for them, and give feedback.

shots.title: Your roster
shots.text: You see only the superintendents assigned to you, and only what each one shares with you.

shots.title: Pick a person
shots.text: Switch between the people you coach or mentor.

shots.title: Their classes
shots.text: Open a class to see their progress, and their submitted work when they share notes and work with you. Grading belongs to the course instructor.

shots.title: Log hours for them
shots.text: Mentors log Mentoring hours only. Hours wait for an administrator’s approval.

title: Building a course
summary: Modules, pages, videos, documents, drafts, dates, requirements, and learner preview.

shots.title: My classes
shots.text: Every course you are assigned to teach. Coaches and mentors who teach keep their usual tabs too.

shots.title: Instructor tools
shots.text: Learner preview and Publish. Review submissions is on Assignments.

shots.title: Announcements
shots.text: Post news to everyone taking the course, now or on a date.

shots.title: Add a module
shots.text: One per week, unit, or topic. Set prerequisites and an unlock date.

shots.title: Add to a module
shots.text: Page, video, slide show, resource, assignment, quiz, or discussion.

shots.title: The editor
shots.text: Format text, add images, links, YouTube or Vimeo videos, and documents. Set dates and the completion requirement.

shots.title: Reorder
shots.text: Move items and modules up and down.

shots.title: Learner preview
shots.text: See exactly what learners see. Drafts and future items are hidden.

shots.title: Publish
shots.text: Drafts are visible only to instructors and administrators until you publish.

title: Reviewing and grading work
summary: Review submissions, rubrics, quizzes, question banks, and revisions.

shots.title: Open your course
shots.text: Open a course you teach from My classes.

shots.title: Review submissions
shots.text: Every assignment, quiz, and graded discussion in one place.

shots.title: Status for each person
shots.text: Not turned in, Submitted, Late, Missing, Needs revision, Reviewed, or Needs grading.

shots.title: Grade and feedback
shots.text: Read their work, score the rubric or points, and write feedback. Request revision opens a new attempt.

shots.title: Question bank
shots.text: Reusable multiple choice, true/false, short answer, and essay questions.

shots.title: Rubrics
shots.text: One row per line: what you look for, points, and ratings.

shots.title: Grading and notifications
shots.text: Default grading and which emails go to people taking the course.

title: Administrators: courses and instructors
summary: Create courses, assign instructors, and use templates.

shots.title: Create a course
shots.text: Code, title, phase, standard, hours, and instructors. It starts as a draft.

shots.title: Course details
shots.text: Instructors are separate from coach and mentor roster assignments. You can start from a template.

shots.title: Every course
shots.text: Administrators can open, edit, and grade every course.

shots.title: Templates and copying
shots.text: Save as a template, apply one, or copy another course. Learner work is never copied.

title: Administrators: roster and approvals
summary: Approve work, record attendance, and add superintendents.

shots.title: At a glance
shots.text: How many superintendents are in each phase.

shots.title: Waiting for approval
shots.text: Sessions marked complete, hours logged, and substitution requests.

shots.title: Approve or Decline
shots.text: Approved items count toward badges right away. A decline asks for a short reason.

shots.title: Search
shots.text: Find someone by name or district. Click View to open their pathway.

shots.title: Superintendent View
shots.text: See exactly what that superintendent sees.

shots.title: Record attendance
shots.text: Give credit for a session to everyone who attended, at once.

shots.title: Attendance
shots.text: Pick the session and date, check who attended, and click Save attendance.

shots.title: Add superintendent
shots.text: Adds them to the roster and emails a link to set a password.

title: Administrators: people and sign-in
summary: Add people, send sign-in links, change roles, and turn accounts off.

shots.title: Add a person
shots.text: For coaches, mentors, MASA staff, and program staff.

shots.title: Email link
shots.text: Emails a one-time link to set a password.

shots.title: Copy link
shots.text: Makes a link you can send yourself.

shots.title: Role
shots.text: Member sees what the roster connects them to; Admin sees everything.

shots.title: Status and last sign-in
shots.text: Who can sign in, whose link is waiting, and when each person last signed in.
